content:
Derek: Heads-up — after today's canary deploy (release/2026-03-18) we're seeing a small but consistent +6-12ms p95 regression on streaming endpoints. Traces point to eventstream write path. Link: https://internal-traces/r/abc123 :eyes:
Carmen: Repro in staging? we didn't see in unit perf tests
Derek: Staging's clean but canary (region-us-east-1) shows it. Perf CI flagged a 9% reg in stream_latency test. perf-bot: auto:perf-test failed: stream_latency (p95 +9%)
Ben: I ran a flamegraph — main delta is in proto/framing.serialize_frame -> memcpy and in toolcall/serialize_tool_output. Both got touched in MR #5421
Alice: MR #5421 was the API streaming framing change + toolcall serialization switch to compact frames
Derek: suspect: new header length-check adds per-frame branching and leads to smaller TCP writes -> Nagle/coalesce change + more syscalls
Eva: Also kernel-autoselect is picking small-sequence kernels for short sequences; that increases per-token overhead when frames are small
Carmen: Any easy repro? can we force the old kernel path and re-run on canary?
Ben: quick test: set ENV KERNEL_PREF=legacy and run a canary replay. Patch attached: ```diff
- if (seq_len < 64) use_opt;
+ if (seq_len < 32) use_opt;
```
Derek: tried that — p95 drops back to baseline in replay. That narrows it.
Maya: So root cause chain: framing change -> smaller frames -> kernel autoselect chooses suboptimal kernel -> more toolcall serializations per stream -> syscalls and memcpy overhead -> p95 increase
Carmen: OK bisect plan: 1) revert MR #5421 framing change in canary 2) rerun perf CI 3) if fixed, we either tweak kernel autoselect thresholds or revert
Ben: I can open a revert PR for just the framing header optimization, mark rollout-hold
perf-bot: deployment hold: rollout paused on service/streaming due to perf alert
Alice: In parallel, can someone run microbench on memcpy path with `strace -c -e write` and capture small_write sizes? also tcpdump to see segment sizes
Eva: I'll run the microbench on canary and upload pcap and strace
Derek: Thanks — if revert fixes, let's plan a proper fix: either increase frame coalescing in the writer, or make kernel-autoselect consider "average frame bytes" metric before switching
Carmen: Also add a CI microtest for streaming with small-frame workloads so this reg doesn't slip again
Ben: Opening revert PR now: #5489 — tagging @eng-runtime and @oncall
Alice: Suggest adding a perf-test that simulates many tiny toolcall frames; small test in `perf/stream_small_frames.py`
Maya: Great plan. Keep this thread updated; I'll coordinate rollback if perf confirms
Derek: will post perf diffs when CI completes — thanks all :thumbsup:
